race.comment: BALMIERRO (4) scored convincingly in a Class 1 over 2200m at Scone two back. Found the gruelling 3120m at Grafton last start beyond him. Big chance to return to winning ways in this more suitable assignment. THUNDERING FALCON (11) has struggled since taking out a Class 1 over 2245m at Grafton three runs back. Best form measures up so don't let him under the guard. SOUND AND VISION (2) has been just behind the placings at all three runs this time in work over shorter journeys. Can improve getting out to this trip at the fourth run back. THINK I'M IRISH (12) doesn't win too often but her last effort at Dubbo was encouraging. CALZINO (3) scored here at this distance last start and still has more to offer at just the fourth run of the campaign.
